review.tagline: Slack and Teams knowledge agent on LangGraph and CopilotKit Channels
review.summary: A deployable Slack and Teams agent in two services: a Node runtime (CopilotRuntime with embedded Channels) and a Python LangGraph deep agent speaking AG-UI. It ships web research, optional GitHub, PostHog, Linear and Notion MCP tools, native Slack charts and a LangGraph interrupt that pauses before Linear or Notion writes, with Slack ingress through a CopilotKit Intelligence managed channel. For teams that want an on-call style bot in chat.
review.audience: Teams that want an on-call style knowledge bot in Slack
strengths: Approval gate before writes is a resumable LangGraph interrupt, not a prompt rule
Railway config and an AWS ECS Fargate deployment are both in the repo
AGENT_URL accepts any AG-UI agent; the runtime does not care about the framework
Published container images; tests and AGENTS.md included
weaknesses: Slack and Teams delivery depends on hosted CopilotKit Intelligence unless you build a runner
Two languages and two processes: Node 22 plus Python 3.12 with uv
OpenAI is the only documented model provider
Setup has several Slack-specific failure modes the README spends pages on
